subject: FOCUS DECISION: post-READY cover-route revocation is partially integrated
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-research-rd-1-readiness-revocation-20261002. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. Broad discovery/scoring selected the post-READY route-drop boundary (priority 28). Current Fold7CoverReadiness correctly downgrades READY -> WAITING_ROUTE when topology is no longer proven, but current Fold7ContinuityCoordinator does not revoke COVER_VISUAL/mirrorRequested; it only calls ensureCoverRouteHeld and may sync/retain the current host. The prior durable Cover Readiness R&D explicitly required route-drop-while-visible to hide locally, retain current visual demand, repair once, and re-show only after fresh readiness. Current tests cover becoming READY and reversal hide, not READY->WAITING_ROUTE while visible. This is treated as an integration-conformance gap, not a new readiness redesign. Independent boundary excludes CAS ownership, native terminal handoff, presentation identity, process recovery, content freshness, angle authority, input gating, visual-phase/frame pacing, and all production writes. Cheapest decisive next action: source-faithful baseline vs corrected exact-demand model with deterministic/adversarial drop/recover/remap/reversal sequences.
